essence: Mere will fruits as three worlds; workings reach past knowing; work-stair climbed by Brahmā.
Power-creeper blooming as gods protects; Mṛḍa errorless, reachless, praised everywhere.
Pride claiming made-of-you yet not in self; rest in mind-bliss after weighing duties.
Subtle yet whole, gross yet unseen; word-nets toiled in vain without you-as-expressible.
Course, rite, wisdom asked: show by teaching, grant grace.

sections.SUMMARY: Bare will bears triple fruit past measure; gods shinny the deed-ladder toward one abode. The power-vine flowers into deities and shields; the stainless one stands unguessed and unreached, hymned in act, memory, vision, touch, arrival. Pride apes union while missing the self; then duty pondered drops into blissful rest. Fineness holds all yet hides from seers; tongues net nothing till you name yourself speakable. So the plea: which road, which rite, which ken reveals you — teach and favour.

rasa.justification: Unknowable reach, unfindable error, unseen grossness, unspoken expressible: wonder circling into plea for teaching.

essence: Needing nothing, helping all three worlds; desired of all, desiring nothing.
Good discernment sows endless-fruited love; great glamour slackens even treasure-holders.
Free doer alone amid all acts; seized worlds need none else's might or mercy.
Fault reaching you turns faultless; greed for you turns worshipful.
Contemplation-deed ennobles worm to Brahmā; beginnings, middles, ends are yours on thought's road.
No savour elsewhere matches love's nectar-liquor.

sections.SUMMARY: The helper wants nothing and feeds all, craved by each, craving none. Clear farmers plant undying affection; the conjuring veil makes even finders drowse. Every start permits, yet only one hand stays free; triple worlds drown till that hand or its kindness hauls out. Vice pointed at you inverts to virtue; clutching at you hallows clutching. One rite of minding you titles grub and godhead alike for freedom; alpha, fray, omega run on mind's lane yours. Beside your love-sap, all relish thins.

rasa.dominant: bhakti with audārya (generosity tasted and returned)
rasa.justification: Help, harvest, hauling, hallowing: gifts moving both ways between Lord and lover, relished as nectar.

essence: Desire withdrawn, longing stretched, moon-crested master bowed; incapable refuge in all-befriending power.
No substitute past strands; nondual self yet cheating glamour; wish-tree sprouts powers, lordship, ending.
Already won, yet when won: tell; clear-heart tenant, ash-white swan bowed.
Twin lamps of waking and love begged; triple play staged and only poet fit to strike.
Real and fake made nought or aught by free-and-bound spender-sovereign.

sections.SUMMARY: Capped hunger bows to the crescent master; empty hands take shelter in all-helping force. Peerless past qualities, the self fools its own through fathomless sheen; still devotion fruits into supernormal bloom, endless sway, birth's close. Won already, the prize stays future — say when; the pellucid-breasted swan keeps house. Two flames are sued, knowing and loving; the worldwright who raised the boards alone can ring them down. Being and non-being trade places at the nod of the boundless bound one.

rasa.justification: Won yet unwon, staged yet unstaged: having bows to becoming; lamps lit against the wait.
